purpose: Teach: 伐採/急性/海峡/激怒/不条理/醸造/戦艦/着工

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、森林伐採による環境影響を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on the environmental impact of deforestation, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, genuinely interested. Casual confirmation—she knows the answer. Light, conversational tempo. Leaning in slightly with recognition.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、急性疾患の早期発見を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about early detection methods in acute disease.
lines.style: Soft, slightly hesitant. Acknowledging her question while offering a small correction. Gentle pace, no defensiveness. Trailing off slightly as if uncertain whether to elaborate.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、津軽海峡の漁業史を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper on the fishing history of the Tsugaru Strait was fascinating, wasn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful, reflective tone. Slower pace—she's genuinely considering what he wrote. Warm but measured, like she's inviting him to reflect with her.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、抑圧された人々の激怒を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on the anger and resistance of oppressed peoples.
lines.style: Quiet but firm. A small note of pride underneath. He's offering his actual subject with care, not apologizing for the correction. Even pace, present.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 社会の不条理を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And you explored the contradictions and absurdities within society itself.
lines.style: Engaged, nodding thoughtfully. She's connecting the dots. Steady voice, genuine respect. Not lecturing—building understanding together.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、伝統的な醸造文化を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, specifically traditional brewing culture and its place in that system.
lines.style: Quietly precise. He's clarifying with care, not irritation. Moderate pace. A hint of satisfaction that she's listening this closely.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、旧海軍の戦艦の歴史を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Your research on the history of the Imperial Navy's battleships was quite thorough.
lines.style: Reflective, measured. She's summing up with respect. Slower cadence. Genuine acknowledgment of the scope of his work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、新幹線の着工史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I examined the development and construction of the Shinkansen system itself.
lines.style: Clear and final. He's offering the last piece with quiet confidence. Firm close. No trailing uncertainty. Direct eye contact in the voice.
